ask: Nobody has looked at the ≥0.94 band: 84 teams at ≥0.94, 28 at ≥0.945, 3 at ≥0.95, against our 0.926 at rank 776.
What do they do, and what of it is verifiable rather than asserted?
This lane looks systematically: every flag, every default, every measured-but-unfixed defect.
What can be bought with the remainder at zero training GPU?
And the efficiency prize is a separate $18,000 track where we are rank 265 and a cheap config is plausibly top-20.
What can be extracted from the 4,349 studies and the ~1,300 test studies we already hold, without a new labeling pass and without touching a standing prohibition?
the final-two selection nobody has registered
rules, prizes, 9 h cap, external data permitted, efficiency formula, LB snapshot
prior RSNA winners, literature, per-pathology AUC levels
pool correlation, marginal gain, instruments, public/private split risk and the winner's curse
the single-model gap, arm C vs the Raptor, screens S1/S2
public checkpoints as members, licences, the Raptor arm
